payload.credit_html:
Own work

Skeletal elements drawn based on Allain & Taquet (2000),"A new Genus of Dromaeosauridae (Dinosauria, Theropoda) from the Upper Cretaceous of France", Journal of Vertebrate Paleontology, 20: 404-407.
payload.description_html: A diagram of the dromaeosaurid dinosaur Pyroraptor olympius with selected fossil elements that can be reliably scaled using measurements given by Allain & Taquet (2000) to produce a realistic estimate of the taxon's size and proportions in life. This silhouette is based on the supposition of the missing elements of Pyroraptor's skeleton having fairly generalized dromaeosaurid proportions.
